objetivo.en_sus_palabras: I don't have a specific aesthetic goal right now — I just want to feel stronger, sleep better, and have more energy day to day. I've never really followed a training program before.

experiencia.detalle: No structured training history, only occasional yoga classes over the years.

alergias_alimentarias: tree nut allergy (walnuts, almonds) — carries an EpiPen

nutricion.contexto: Vegan for 4 years, cooks most of her own meals and is comfortable in the kitchen. Works from home, so timing meals around training is flexible.

notas_libres: First time working with a trainer. A bit nervous about starting but motivated — mentioned she'd like check-ins along the way to know if she's doing it right.
